title: Domestic shipping
text: Domestic orders placed in India are dispatched within two business days. Standard delivery takes three to five business days after dispatch. Express delivery takes one to two business days after dispatch. Public holidays may add one day.

title: International shipping
text: International delivery is available to the United States and Singapore. Standard international delivery takes seven to ten business days after dispatch. Customs duties are payable by the customer. We do not ship to other international destinations.

title: Product returns
text: Unused items with original packaging can be returned within fourteen calendar days after delivery. A purchase receipt is required. Used goods and clearance items cannot be returned unless defective. Contact support to obtain a return authorization.

title: Refund processing
text: After an eligible return passes warehouse inspection, the refund is sent to the original payment method within five to seven business days. Bank posting may take another two business days. Return shipping is nonrefundable unless the item was defective.

title: Hardware warranty
text: New hardware has a twelve month limited manufacturing defect warranty starting from delivery. Accidental damage, liquid damage, and normal wear are excluded. Warranty service requires proof of purchase and a support ticket.

title: Account password reset
text: To reset a password, select Forgot password on the sign in screen, enter the registered email, and use the reset link valid for thirty minutes. Support agents never ask customers to disclose passwords or one time codes.

title: Human support hours
text: Live chat support operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 India Standard Time, excluding public holidays. Email tickets can be submitted at any time and receive an initial response within two business days.

title: Personal data requests
text: Customers can request a copy of their account data from the Privacy page. Identity verification is required before export. Account deletion requests are processed within thirty calendar days, unless retention is legally required.

title: Developer API limits
text: The free developer plan allows one hundred API requests per minute. The paid developer plan allows one thousand requests per minute. A request over the limit receives HTTP 429 and should be retried with exponential backoff.

title: Escalation policy
text: For unresolved shipping or billing incidents, open a support ticket with the order reference. If no resolution is provided within three business days, request escalation to the support lead. High severity security incidents are routed immediately.
